## Choose how and where you build

Manage your environment on any [supported infrastructure](/en/technologies/cloud-computing/openshift/self-managed#cloud-providers) or cloud—or let Red Hat manage it for you on one of our partner cloud platforms. However you want to run, there’s a Red Hat OpenShift edition to meet your needs.

Managed cloud services

## Managed cloud services

Red Hat OpenShift is available as a managed application platform on the cloud provider of your choice. Make the most of your existing cloud investments by using your [committed spend](/en/topics/cloud-computing/committed-spend "What is committed spend?") on Red Hat products and services.

[![Learn more about Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS](https://www.redhat.com/rhdc/managed-files/Logo-Red_Hat-AWS-A-Standard-RGB.svg)](/en/technologies/cloud-computing/openshift/aws "Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS")

[![Learn more about Microsoft Azure Red Hat OpenShift](https://www.redhat.com/rhdc/managed-files/rh-partner-logo-microsoft-azure.svg)](/en/technologies/cloud-computing/openshift/azure "Microsoft Azure Red Hat OpenShift")

Self-managed editions

## Self-managed editions

Red Hat OpenShift’s self-managed editions build upon each other, giving you the flexibility to choose the features that matter most to you.

![Red Hat OpenShift Platform Plus](/rhdc/managed-files/Logo-Red_Hat-OpenShift_Platform_Plus.svg)

A suite of solutions with advanced multicluster security and management to build and scale applications across environments. 

![Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform](/rhdc/managed-files/Logo-Red_Hat-OpenShift_Container_Platform-A-Standard-RGB_0.svg)

A complete platform with services and tools to develop, operate, and modernize applications. 

![Red Hat OpenShift Kubernetes Engine](/rhdc/managed-files/Logo-Red_Hat-Openshift_Kub_Engine-A-Standard-RGB.svg)

An enterprise Kubernetes runtime for container orchestration and management.

![Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization Engine](/rhdc/managed-files/Logo-Red_Hat-OpenShift_Virtualization_Engine-A-Standard-RGB_1.svg)

A cost-effective solution to migrate, deploy, manage, and scale virtual machines exclusively.

[Compare self-managed editions](/en/technologies/cloud-computing/openshift/self-managed "Red Hat OpenShift self‑managed editions")
